repos.name: andy1245-rgb/PolyCrawler
repos.category: Wallet clustering by funding, backtest-first insider discovery
repos.method: Read src/polycrawler/discovery/{flagging,links,funding,engine}.py and research/*.md. Step 1 flags wallets from data strictly before a splitDate: isNew (age <= 14 d), isFocused (markets traded <= 15), isLongshot (avg buy <= 0.3), isBig (>= $1000), and a 5th signal; flagged when >= minSignals (default 4; config row 15/0.3/4 gives 187 suspicious, 7/9 labelled recall). Step 2 traces Polygon USDC funding through Etherscan V2 (10 pages x 1000 cap) and links accounts by shared funder, shared cash-out, direct transfer and a 1-hop grandparent link, with hub and exchange addresses blocked. Clusters are held as net exposure per market. Then copy-trade backtests with no lookahead.
repos.data_sources: Polymarket Gamma/Data/CLOB APIs, Etherscan V2 (chain 137), Alchemy, Dune order bursts, Relay API
repos.strengths: Out-of-time design (labels and funding cut at splitDate), 9 labelled wallets for recall, manual review of 20 flagged accounts (8 insider/likely, 4 possible, 8 speculator, precision 40-60%), rolling monthly rule test where nothing made money outside the Iran/Venezuela events, an adversarial self-audit (research/methodologyAttack.md) that finds three different burst definitions and a selection on future intra-burst information. Published negative results.
repos.limits: Funding is read for whole history up to a cutoff but hub status is judged from samples; Etherscan key needed; Etherscan 10,000-row window; V1 era Iran/Venezuela cases; README admits 1 failing test and no validated edge; the 'winner' label is used to rank pre-split markets (fine, resolved before split). Only 9 labels.
repos.point_in_time_risks: Low for discovery (buys filtered ts < cutoff, markets resolved < cutoff, activity cut at cutoff). Own audit finds whole-burst entry selection uses future legs in research scripts (entrySweep.py:107-114) but not in src/strategy.py. Funding rows beyond the cutoff: not verified.
repos.tests: 196 tests in 26 files (README: 195 pass, 1 fails); fixtures present (tests/fixtures/*.json), looks executable offline with uv run pytest (not run). No CI.
repos.reimplement_spec: Four-signal pre-cutoff flag as a point-in-time baseline against our Nobel replay. Inputs: fills and resolution times, wallet first-activity time, all dated before the cutoff t. Per wallet, best winning buy: signals = account age <= 14 d at first buy; markets traded <= 15 before t; avg buy price <= 0.30; buy >= $1000; flag if >= 4 of the 5 signals (grid 3/4, caps 5/15/30, price 0.3/0.5/0.7). Score = flagged or not; evaluate recall on our labelled cases and precision by manual review of a random 20. Funding link rule: wallets sharing a non-hub funder (hub = funder with > N distinct recipients) before t. Compare with our alert classes without changing frozen ones.
repos.reimplement_note: Method only, apache licence allows reading but we still write our own code.

repos.name: jonathanhawkins/polymarket-graphrag

Ingests trades into Neo4j, traces USDC funding to depth 2 via Etherscan v2, reproduces the Theo whale cluster and a realised PnL of about $78.4M (92% of Bloomberg's $85M). STORY.md documents three stacked false-positive layers for shared-funder rules: protocol contracts, exchange hot wallets (Kraken 72 funds 7 of the 16 top winners) and order-book counterparties; only shared private funders paired with correlated bet timing count.

repos.limits: One case study (2024 election, 20 markets); no tests; no licence; LLM chat layer; code not read beyond the story and file names.

Test: count how many of our C4/C5 alerts survive each filter on the Nobel replay.

repos.name: Samy-z/PolyClusters
repos.method: Read README.md and polyclusters/analysis/cluster.py (header). Net positions per (wallet, market, outcome) bet key; IDF-weighted, size-weighted (log USD) sparse user x bet matrix, cosine similarity threshold 0.35, min 2 shared bets, bets held by > 25% of the pool dropped as stopwords, price band 0.03-0.92, timing bonus for entries within 6 h, Louvain communities, then cluster metrics (unanimity, ROI, edge per share, entry vs VWAP).
repos.data_sources: Polymarket Gamma keyset and Data API /trades with time slicing
repos.strengths: Explicit control for the 98-cent favourite artefact; rarity weighting; documents Data API limits (offset cap 10,000, 422 on /events offset).
repos.limits: No chain data or funding; desktop Qt app; one test file; winners metrics use resolved outcome (descriptive).
repos.point_in_time_risks: Clustering uses whole-history positions and resolution-based win rates: retrospective. No as-of cut. Not verified whether suspicion score uses outcomes (README lists win rate and ROI inside it).
repos.tests: 1 test file; offline status not verified.
repos.reimplement_spec: Co-betting graph as a funding-free alternative link. Inputs: net position per wallet and outcome, entry timestamps. Weight each shared bet by idf = ln(N_wallets / n_holders); vector = log(1+USD) * idf, L2-normalised; edge if cosine >= 0.35 and shared bets >= 2 and both entries within 6 h; drop bets with holder fraction > 0.25 and entries priced > 0.92 or < 0.03. Evaluate on the frozen cases by asking whether known cluster members land in one community using only fills dated before the alert.

repos.name: Antoinechss/Polymarket-coalition-detection
repos.license: none (no LICENSE file): all rights reserved
repos.category: V2 OrderFilled decoding plus streaming anomaly score
repos.method: Read ingest/decoders/orders_filled.py, common/params.py and anomaly_detection/anomaly_scorer.py. Decoder reads topic 0xd543adfd..., maker and taker from topics, data words side, tokenId, makerAmountFilled, takerAmountFilled, fee; BUY when side 0 (pUSD in); stores tx_hash, log_index, block, order_hash. Scorer: River HalfSpaceTree, QuantileFilter q=0.999, warmup 1000, score before learn, features log buy USDC, n buys, avg buy, net shares, avg buy price, potential profit.
repos.strengths: Decodes the same V2 event as ours with log index and block; online scoring that scores before learning (no leakage by construction).
repos.limits: Decoder reads only the first 5 data words (ignores builder and metadata) and does not handle the aggregate taker-order log; the third exchange 0xe3333700... is labelled 'V2' while other sources list different addresses; no tests; unsupervised score has no labels.

repos.name: bradca0/polymarket-pnl (PolyEdge, package pmsr)
repos.license: none (no LICENSE file, GitHub API null): all rights reserved
repos.category: Position and PnL reconstruction plus skill scoring
repos.method: Read README.md, src/pmsr/pnl.py and src/pmsr/skill.py. Folds six Data API activity types into cash and token balances (TRADE, SPLIT, MERGE, REDEEM, REWARD excluded by default, CONVERSION counted and skipped); recovers token for SPLIT/MERGE/REDEEM rows from clobTokenIds and treats outcomeIndex 999 on REDEEM as the winner; dedupes on the full economic tuple; validates on token balances against /positions (829/901 positions, 92.0%, 43/51 wallets exact). Skill: edge per dollar and calibration gap (hit rate minus rate implied by entry prices), Brier versus market, shrunk toward the population mean; backtest splits by resolution date.
repos.strengths: Validates the fold on quantities, not on a PnL definition; shrinkage; point-in-time split by resolution date; published negative result (skill-weighted flow does not beat price, ROI -3.3%).
repos.limits: No chain logs; ignores NegRisk conversions; sample of 51 validated wallets; Data API only; no licence.
repos.point_in_time_risks: Designed to avoid it (skill estimated only on markets resolved before the cut). Fill price used as the market price (admitted in market_brier docstring).
repos.tests: 4 test files (test_pnl, test_skill, test_forecast, test_data_api); offline status not run.
repos.reimplement_spec: Ledger check for our Nobel replay wallets. Inputs: Data API activity per wallet plus market token ids. cash += usdcSize on SELL, MERGE, REDEEM; cash -= on BUY, SPLIT; tokens +/- size per asset (SPLIT/MERGE both tokens); dedupe on (tx, type, asset, side, size, price, timestamp, conditionId). Pass criterion: token balance equals /positions size within 1 token, report share of wallets that reconcile exactly. Skill shrinkage: shrunk = raw * n/(n+k) toward population mean with k set by the between-wallet variance, applied only with markets resolved before the alert.

research.title: Whether Is Not When: Separating Occurrence from Timing in Polymarket Prices
research.summary: Splits the information in Polymarket prices into whether an event happens and when. Timing carries about one eighth of it. Useful as a decomposition if we date information times, but it is not an insider detection method (abstract level, REPORTED).

research.title: What Prediction-Market Contracts Reveal at Launch: Trading Volume and Dispute Risk
research.summary: Predicts lifetime volume and settlement disputes from listing-time information. Accuracy drops sharply when tested on later periods, a reminder to validate out of time (abstract level, REPORTED). Not about insiders.

research.title: Reading the Count: Prediction Markets and Brazil's 2026 Presidential Election
research.summary: Compares minute-by-minute vote counts with Kalshi and Polymarket trades. Markets reacted faster than a live projection. Gives a minute-level reaction timing method that could source information times (abstract level, REPORTED).

research.title: Measuring Trade Direction in a Prediction Market (already in the published benchmark)

research.summary: Already listed. Profit persistence and copy-trading feasibility; consistent with tlafargue's zero persistence result (abstract level, REPORTED).

Heuristics, no validation.

research.title: Search result: no new peer-reviewed or arXiv insider-detection paper dated after 2026-10-01 was found
research.summary: arXiv API keyword search for polymarket sorted by date shows nothing newer than 2611.00338 (2026-10-30). Web search found only items before October (ACDC military-markets study, August 2026; ForesightFlow arXiv v2 May 2026; Mitts and Ofir informed-trading study). selection_rules: Candidates came from gh search repos with roughly 60 queries (polymarket plus insider, detection, cluster, wallet, graph, sybil, wash, pnl, forensic, anomaly, alerts, indexer, smart money, coalition, vpin, manipulation) and gh search code for the V2 OrderFilled topic hash. Rules: (1) Polymarket-specific and public; (2) code or reproducible data present (a repo with only a README was dropped unless noted); (3) pushed on or after 2026-01-01; (4) not one of the eight, nor the scout set already in the 20 Nov REPORT; (5) at least one of: wallet clustering or funding, PnL or fill reconstruction, V2 decoding, point-in-time or negative-result research, or live surveillance; (6) stars used only as a tie-break because all are under 50. Two repositories returned 404 and were dropped (Xda1Dan/wallet-forensics, x-pertknight/polymarket-insider-detection). 24 repositories are listed; 14 were read at file level (PolyCrawler, graphrag STORY, PolyClusters, coalition, bradca0, polyflux card, envio indexer config, poly-sniff metrics, NickNaskida, suislanchez, whongach notebook, anthonylin99, tlafargue, rwondo README), the rest at README or tree level, marked as such. Nothing was cloned or executed; all reads went through gh api contents. Many other candidates exist in integrations/forensic-intelligence/external_registry.json (218 entries) and were not re-read here.
matrix_criteria: Point-in-time replay: funding, wallet age and labels are read as of the trade block or time, and a test proves it
Own V1 and V2 OrderFilled decoding with tx, log index and block per fill (and handling of the N+1 aggregate taker log, boundary block 89,093,736)
Coverage of the full V2 contract set (three exchanges, pUSD, collateral adapters), cross-checked against an independent indexer
pUSD and USDC.e collateral handled in funding and PnL
Funding graph depth, with hub, exchange, bridge and protocol exclusion and fan-out measured before the entry
Cross-chain exit tracing
Position and PnL ledger covering SPLIT, MERGE, REDEEM and NegRisk CONVERSION, validated on token balances against an independent source
Immutable or hash-chained alert log with detector version stamp
Out-of-sample or out-of-time validation (frozen split by date)
Negative controls (same-market same-day same-side, matched control markets, random markets, decoy groups)
Published negative verdict with a corrected alpha for the number of tests
Sourced first-public-information time per case (GDELT, Wayback, outlet tiers)
Labelled case set size and recall reporting
Population-scale wallet ranking published (rows, not only alerts)
Persistence test of wallet skill (split-half rank correlation)
Live delivery channel and measured trade-to-alert latency
Tests executable offline and CI with a version matrix
Licence permits reuse (MIT or Apache versus none or non-derivative)
Evidence package reproducible offline from committed data with SHA-256 lists
Data availability: committed data versus private or paid API
